mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) may inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, potentially increasing carbamazepine levels, while carbamazepine induces CYP3A4, which may decrease curcumin bioavailability.
action: Monitor carbamazepine serum levels and seizure control if turmeric supplementation is initiated or discontinued; counsel patient to maintain consistent turmeric intake and report breakthrough seizures.
